title: Optimization Subject to Two Simultaneous Constraints
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the difference between the maximum and minimum values of f(x, y, z) = z subject to x + y + z = 1 and x^2 + y^2 = 1.

steps.title: Express z in Terms of Constraint Variables
steps.explanation: From the planar constraint x + y + z = 1, z is maximized when x + y is minimized.

steps.title: Optimize x + y on the Unit Circle
steps.explanation: The extrema of x + y on the unit circle are +- sqrt(2).
steps.why: Finding extreme values of x + y.
